title: Proposal
description: RFC 0096 §B. A reviewable-learning proposal — an INERT, draft-state reusable artifact (skill/pack/template/automation) the host synthesized from run/tool traces, that MUST NOT influence the resolution, planning, or execution of any run while in any state other than `applied`. Activation is delegated to RFC 0051 approval-gate or RFC 0049 RBAC (no new authorization path). On `apply` the installed artifact MUST byte-match the last-persisted `artifact` (no silent re-synthesis). `rationale` and `provenance.sourceRunIds` are SR-1 redaction-safe (no secrets/PII). Gated on the `agents.proposals` capability. RFC 0249: served by `getProposal` / `listProposals`; on apply, `activation.installedArtifact` names the v2 read that serves the installed bytes, and those bytes minus the kind's host-owned fields MUST be RFC 8785 (JCS) equal to the last-persisted `artifact`.

kind.description: The reusable artifact kind. `agent-pack` (RFC 0003), `workflow-chain-pack` (RFC 0013), `prompt-template` (RFC 0027), `automation` (RFC 0052 scheduled job).

state.description: Lifecycle state. Only `applied` may influence a run. `draft`/`revised` are inert; `rejected`/`archived` are terminal-inert.

rationale.description: Plain-language justification. SR-1 redaction-safe — no secrets/PII.

artifact.description: The proposed artifact, shaped by `kind` (an RFC 0003 pack manifest, an RFC 0013 chain pack, an RFC 0027 template, an RFC 0052 job spec). Inert until applied. Deliberately open (`additionalProperties` not constrained here) because the payload conforms to the kind's own existing schema, validated by the host at `apply` (malformed-for-kind ⇒ 422).
artifact.$comment: Intentionally open object — the artifact body is validated against the kind's own schema, not this envelope.

artifactDigest.description: RFC 0249 §C. `sha256:` followed by the lowercase hex SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 (JCS) serialization of `artifact`, recomputed on every revision. `applyProposal` binds to it: a sent digest that differs from this value is refused `409 proposal_stale`.

sourceRunIds.description: Runs whose traces produced this proposal (RFC 0040 causation-compatible). SR-1 redaction-safe.

synthesizerModel.description: Opaque identifier of the model/process that synthesized the draft.

duplicateOf.description: Existing artifact ref this proposal restates/overlaps, when `agents.proposals.duplicationDetection` is on. `null` when unknown or detection is off.

owner.description: RFC 0048 identity triple that owns this proposal. Redaction-safe — `principal` is an opaque id, never PII or credential material. Single-tenant hosts populate at least `tenant`.

workspace.description: Optional sub-tenant within the tenant (RFC 0048 workspace).

principal.description: Acting identity (user or agent) — opaque id, never PII.

activation.description: Populated only when `state: applied`: the RFC 0051 approval reference (if `activation = approval-gate`) and the resulting installed artifact ref.

approvalId.description: RFC 0051 approval/gate id when activation routed through an approval gate.

installedArtifactRef.description: Opaque ref of the artifact installed on `apply` (RFC 0043 install path). A client MUST NOT treat it as resolvable; `installedArtifact` is the resolvable form (RFC 0249).

installedArtifact.description: RFC 0249 §C. The v2 read that serves the installed artifact. `operationId` names a GET operation in `spec/v2/path-manifest.json`, evaluated in the applying tenant's scope; for any other tenant the installed artifact answers as an unknown id. The body that operation returns, with the kind's host-owned fields removed from both sides (`meta` for `prompt-template`; none for `workflow-chain-pack` and `agent-pack`, RFC 0253 §C), MUST be RFC 8785 (JCS) equal to the `artifact` last persisted before apply. For the two pack kinds the obligation holds while the installed version equals `version`.

kind.description: The installed artifact's kind; equals the proposal's `kind`.

operationId.description: A GET operation in `spec/v2/path-manifest.json` (for `prompt-template`, `getPromptTemplate`; for `workflow-chain-pack` and `agent-pack`, `getInstalledPack`).

id.description: The path parameter that operation takes. It MUST be the artifact's own identifier (for `prompt-template`, `artifact.templateId`; for the two pack kinds, `artifact.name`); a host MUST NOT mint one.

version.description: The installed version, when the read surface is versioned. REQUIRED for `workflow-chain-pack` and `agent-pack`, where it is `artifact.version` (RFC 0253 §B).
